question: Codex arm4-a #9: is the v1 evaluation of a fixed snapshot invariant to the evaluator layout (3 x 8 vs 6 x 8)?
conclusion: repeated evaluations of one snapshot are not bit-reproducible even with the same layout (renderer +/-1 intensity noise, GPU nondeterminism); in this single comparison the 3 x 8 vs 6 x 8 difference was larger than the same-layout repeat (max per-camera success difference 0.15 vs 0.05; return 278 vs 58) while the suite means stayed within 0.025-0.05 - layout invariance is NOT established, so each arm uses its reference invocation: A / B 3 x 8 as Original, C / D 6 x 8 as cst50 (Codex arm4-a #9 accepted)
